title: Reviewed Account and Contact QA preview
description: As a QA analyst I want to preview Account and Contact business cases, verify their owned relationship independently and retain reviewed failure evidence. These are synthetic fixture contracts, not claims about a live Salesforce org.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A valid Account preview displays Draft ready and its owned Name matches independent API data.
An empty draft surname displays Surname required and the independent mock draft validator returns REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING. No invalid record is saved.
Exactly 80 draft surname characters display Length accepted. The unchanged owned Contact still references the owned Account; the preview is not a persisted edit.
The related Account preview displays Synthetic QA Account and independent SOQL verifies Contact.AccountId.
The restricted read preview displays Insufficient access and independent mock access returns INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS.
The reviewed Contact preview displays Known rule restored and its owned LastName matches independent SOQL.
The Contact preview displays Layout approved and matches its separately reviewed masked fixture baseline and accessible preview button.
